errors: The machine_order constraint sums the big-M disjunctive expression over all job pairs (j,k) into one inequality, instead of enforcing it for each pair. The 24 non-selected pairs each add about 2000 of slack, so the constraint never binds and jobs can overlap on a machine.

The makespan of 28 is therefore far too low. A valid permutation flow shop schedule must serialise the jobs on each machine, so the true optimum is much larger.
